`rota.plot` draws results in one call, with the unit, the dB reference and the amplitude convention in the labels. The figures below are drawn with these functions on realistic synthetic recordings — a four-cylinder engine run-up with upshifts and an electric drive whose gear whine passes a resonance — taken from the gallery of 0.8.0 (where the package is imported as `rota_order`; the functions are the same). All fifteen functions: [docs/plotting.md](https://github.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/blob/v0.8.0/docs/plotting.md).

```python
import rota.plot as rp   # 0.7; pip install "rota-order[plot]==0.7.0"
```

**Campbell diagram with the firing orders** — `rp.rpm_frequency_map(fmap, **rp.SOUND_PRESSURE, mark_orders=(2, 4, 6))`

![Campbell diagram](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/v0.8.0/docs/images/plot_rpm_frequency_map.png)

**Order map** — `rp.rpm_order_map(omap, **rp.SOUND_PRESSURE, mark_orders=(2, 4, 6))`

![Order map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/v0.8.0/docs/images/plot_rpm_order_map.png)

**Before and after on one colour scale, with the dB difference** — `rp.compare_maps({"original": m, "order 40 -10 dB": m_new}, **rp.SOUND_PRESSURE, difference=True, dynamic_range=70)`

![compare_maps](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/v0.8.0/docs/images/plot_compare_maps.png)

**Order slices against the truth** — `rp.order_slice({"order 2": s2, "order 4": s4}, **rp.SOUND_PRESSURE, truth={...})`

![order_slice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/v0.8.0/docs/images/plot_order_slice.png)

**Tacholess speed through the upshifts** — `rp.rpm_from_ridge(ridge, reference=(t, rpm))`

![rpm_from_ridge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/v0.8.0/docs/images/plot_rpm_from_ridge.png)

**Tone prominence against the ECMA-418-1 criterion** — `rp.order_prominence(prom)`

![order_prominence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/v0.8.0/docs/images/plot_order_prominence.png)

**1/3-octave band levels along rpm** — `rp.band_levels_vs_rpm(bands, **rp.SOUND_PRESSURE)`

![band_levels_vs_rpm](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/v0.8.0/docs/images/plot_band_levels_vs_rpm.png)
